summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing an investor presentation and press release announcing an EGM scheduled for June 8, 2026. The presentation references a planned transaction with Royal Uranium Inc., though no definitive terms, price per share, or premium are disclosed. The EGM will consider three unspecified resolutions. The filing is a routine disclosure of an investor update and meeting notice, not a standalone special situation. The registrant is the issuer. What to watch: shareholder approval outcomes and updates on the Royal Uranium transaction.
